status: protocol and plumbing only; no prospective result
scope: forward extension of the existing LVN study, separate from the two future TWAP and funding studies
feature: typical-price candle-volume proxy; occupied bins only
decision_clock: all used inputs received, parsed and persisted before decision; current snapshot cannot imply historical availability
controls: prior-day same-asset same-UTC-hour non-events; no reuse or overlap; underlying feature reconstructed for controls
data_plan: human-initiated bounded collections only; smoke collection validates acquisition, not study sampling density
minimum_evaluation_gate: at least 20 new UTC days and 30 matched non-overlapping pairs, plus coverage review; collection gate, not statistical proof
holdout: freeze code/config commit before first complete new UTC day; reserve final 10 qualified UTC days without outcome inspection; purge 65 minutes at boundaries
evaluation: one primary mean paired markout contrast; dependence-aware inference must account for shared control/event days; no inference until design review
changes: record amendments before new outcomes are inspected; inspected holdouts become development data
executable_claims: bid/ask snapshots support conditional cost checks only; no order fills, queue position, size or profitability inference
